quotes.quote: Blackbaud delivers AI-powered software for nonprofits, education, foundations, & companies, helping organizations drive greater social impact.

Integrating Raiser’s Edge NXT with Financial Edge NXT helps operations teams reduce reconciliation work, improve data confidence, and keep fundraising and finance aligned throughout the full lifecycle of a gift or grant. With both systems connected, teams gain shared visibility from funding to disbursement, making it easier to track where money came from, which fund it was applied to, and how it was ultimately used—helping ensure gifts and grants are used for their intended purposes and supporting transparency for restricted funds. This reduces manual crosschecking between systems, lowers reporting and audit risk, and gives both development and finance teams confidence they are working from the same, trusted data—without relying on spreadsheets or parallel processes.
